proposed_fix.description: Conditionally investigate and remediate node-level network configuration for the checkoutservice host, with all actions gated by human approval.
steps: Await on-call approval to inspect the host node's network interfaces, firewall rules, and routing tables for misconfigurations causing outbound latency.
If node network degradation is confirmed, await approval to cordon the node and reschedule checkoutservice pods to healthy nodes.
If latency persists after rescheduling, await approval to temporarily increase the node's TX queue length via sysctl, with an automatic revert scheduled after 60 minutes.
preconditions: Confirm checkoutservice pods are currently scheduled on the suspected node and that latency metrics (E4) and trace delays (E5) remain elevated.
Verify that target nodes for rescheduling have sufficient CPU/memory capacity and healthy network interfaces.
proposed_fix.rollback: Uncordon the original node, reschedule checkoutservice pods back to it, and revert any sysctl network parameter changes to their default values.
